text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For the Fan Appreciation Festival, Cesario was apparently participating in a VR obstacle race. She had arrived at its setting—a deserted island in virtual space.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky (Commentator)
text_block_list.text:
"VR Space☆Deserted Island Circuit Crazy Race"!
I'm your commentator, Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky (Commentator)
text_block_list.text:
An inter-team mishmash run!
I wonder which trio will help each other on to victory♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To be able to join you, Spe-san...! 
Fufu, I feel like there's some kind of fate bringing us together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Me too! With this lineup, I'm sure we can land a great placement!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Bring on whatever craziness it might be, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky (Commentator)
text_block_list.text:
—Right, right... The prize for winning this time
is an all-you-can-eat pass for the Fan Thanksgiving stalls~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All-you-can-eat at the food stalls?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hamburg steak, curry, yakisoba...
e-every single one of them...!? —*slurp*!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san has a look of pure bliss on her face—
Buena-san. We must seize victory in this match no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Spe-san takes great care of us...
We definitely have to get her an all-you-can-eat voucher!

text_block_list.name: Other Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaaaah!!"
"Hey, stop shaking it~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky (Commentator)
text_block_list.text:
—The first obstacle is the wobbly suspension bridge~!
Swaying to the right, swaying to the left... Watch your step!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—Hm.
Right from the start, figuring out the strategy is a puzzle.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With more people, the bridge sways even harder.
Should we wait until the congestion clears up?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: “Still, it's frustrating watching the gap widen with the leader... What should we do?”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Footprints under the bushes, and... the way that branch is broken...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle! Rustle rustle rustle!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay! It really is a game trail~!
Both of you, please come over here~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh... There's a path here!?
We can totally take a shortcut past the bridge!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I used to see them in the mountains all the time as a kid.
I'd shout 'Look, a grass tunnel!' and run right through!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...According to the rules, shortcuts
were not prohibited.
Taking a shortcut shouldn't be an issue.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It seems my perspective was too narrow.
Your guiding example and keen insight—I have much to learn from them.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aw, shucks, it's not that big a deal... Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky (Commentator)
text_block_list.text:
—Well, well, what a totally rad shortcut!
"Team Spe-Spe" rockets right into the lead pack!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! This is the "Spe-Spe" power!
With my Dosanko spirit, I'll run all the way through~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
MmhââIs that a wild boar?
It seems it won't let us pass easily.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll distract the wild boar.
In the meantime, you two go on ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wait. Over there...
There's a sweet potato lying on the ground, suspiciously out of place!
If we use that...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Mr. Boar, here's your meal—hiya!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It ran off that way! Now's our chance!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
An underground maze is... n-not scary at all!
Both of you, please follow me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait, owieee?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san, are you alright!?
Um, it's dangerous, so you really should keep your eyes open...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky (Commentator)
text_block_list.text: “—Now, now, the finish line is in sight~! It's a chaotic, fierce battle... and leading the pack is Team Spe-Spe!”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky (Commentator)
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, the real battle starts here, I tell ya!
Here's the final obstacle~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Up ahead, there's only a rock wall.
No way... it's a dead end~?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Even though I can see the goal flag... maybe I took the wrong path.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hmm... "There is no path," you say?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It seems my perspective was too narrow.
Your guiding example and keen insight—I have much to learn from them.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—The ocean. If the land is blocked,
we'll take to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The ocean... I get it! Either way,
all I have to do is reach the goal flag, right?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Then let's finish off with everyone going for a swim!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Hyah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLASH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash splash! Splash splash splash!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The shore is close—just a little further!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Results announcement!
The winner of the 'VR Space☆Deserted Island Lap Crazy Race' is—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"—Team Spe-Spe!!
Congratulations! Woo-hoooo!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone on the team cheering each other on
and supporting one another... That's true youth!
Seeing the young ones gave this big sis such a rush~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
――We did it, we did it!
All-you-can-eat at the food stalls! It's a victory party for the three of us~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look at Spe-san smiling like that.
I'm so glad you won, Cesario-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we pulled it off.
Being able to deliver a wonderful victory to Spe-san
is a tremendous point of pride for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario succeeded in treating Special Week to an all-you-can-eat meal.
Seeing her radiant smile warmed my heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Nfufu♪ A-N-D... That's not all, there's one more thing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "The 'Fan-Voted Best Team Award'! You also receive a carrot parfait from the academy's garden~!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-E-Even a carrot parfait!?
We can have a sweets party right after the food stalls~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The Nice Team Award... Spe-san and us...!
That means our teamwork was recognized, right?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, this might be a prize even better than winning...!
I feel like running around the island one more time with the three of us!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, I know! Let's take a commemorative photo later!
"Team Spe-Spe" is forever!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We united to run rough roads and swim the sea.
Had even one person been missing, we wouldn't have claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san, Buena-san. This victory—
is an unfading medal that will shine in our hearts forever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario took 1st place through sheer teamwork.
Her proud demeanor shone brightly after running
her heart out for Special Week.
